_about: Regulation-to-tag map and subject-line cue regexes used by classify_filing.py. Documented for the agent in skills/classify-a-filing/references/tag-regex-table.md. All regexes are case-insensitive and run on whitespace-collapsed text. If SEBI renumbers a regulation, the document in front of you wins: record what it says and report the difference.

subclause_overrides.why: Reg 52(7)/(7A) is the statement of utilisation / deviation of debt issue proceeds
Reg 52(8) is the newspaper publication of debt-listed results, not the results themselves

known_other_regulations.39: loss of share certificates / issue of duplicates
known_other_regulations.40: transfer and transmission of securities certificate
known_other_regulations.44: voting results of a shareholders' meeting
known_other_regulations.47: newspaper advertisement (including the published results extract)
known_other_regulations.56: documents furnished to the debenture trustee
known_other_regulations.58: documents sent to holders of debt securities
